name: What is the difference between a portable and a fixed shower seat?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a portable and a fixed shower seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: A portable shower seat, often a stool or chair, is not permanently attached and can be moved in and out of the shower as needed. This offers flexibility and is ideal for temporary needs or rented homes. A fixed shower seat, on the other hand, is permanently installed, either mounted to the wall or built into the shower structure. Fixed seats provide greater stability and a more integrated appearance, but they cannot be easily removed or relocated. The choice depends on whether you need flexibility or permanent stability and aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Portable shower seats are movable and flexible, while fixed seats are permanently installed, offering greater stability and an integrated look.
